title: detector_card
description: EchoForge detector_card document. Declares a loadable detector (algorithm + parameters + thresholds + expected performance + citations) that the pack-loader instantiates as a `Box<dyn Detector>` at runtime. Externalizes the previously-hardcoded Rust enum dispatch so radar engineers can author new detector configurations or pull in non-Rust detectors via the optional `external_binary` block (stdio JSONL, gRPC, or FFI). Strict-open: each algorithm cites Skolnik / Rohling / Ward-Tough-Watts / Chen / Carlson-Evans-Wilson / Stone-Streit / Kelly / Reed-Mallett-Brennan as applicable. References: tips/detectors/tip{1..8}.txt for the OSINT detector-family matrix; existing implementations at crates/echoforge-radar/src/{cfar.rs,detectors/*.rs,fusion/*.rs}.

algorithm_family.description: Built-in algorithm family. The pack-loader's factory table maps each family string to a Rust constructor (or to an external_binary adapter when present).

parameters.description: Free-form parameter object validated by the per-family Rust struct. Common params: training_cells, guard_cells, pfa, k_quantile (OS-CFAR), mti_order, doppler_bins, hough_accumulator_size, classifier_features, fusion_weights, etc.

default_thresholds.description: Default decision thresholds (e.g. {pfa: 1e-3, micro_doppler_lrt_threshold: 4.5}); may be overridden at runtime.

intended_target_classes.description: Slugs of source_platform_card / object_card classes this detector is calibrated for.

intended_sensor_archetypes.description: Slugs of radar_platform_card / sensor_archetype documents this detector is matched to (band, waveform, dwell, etc.).

expected_performance_envelope.description: Cited (algorithm × target_class × sensor_archetype) → expected (Pd, Pfa) bands. Used by `radar-expert-credibility-report` to confirm performance falls in published envelopes.

external_binary.description: Optional spec for non-Rust detector binaries. The pack-loader spawns a subprocess (stdio JSONL), connects to a gRPC service, or loads a shared library via FFI based on `ipc_protocol`. Each card MUST also declare `parameters.command` or `parameters.endpoint` per protocol.

container_image.description: Optional OCI image reference (e.g. 'echoforge/detector-foo:1.2.0'). When present, the loader runs the detector in container isolation.

schema_url.description: Schema URL for the IPC payload (input view + output detections).

graph_topology.description: For `algorithm_family: detector_graph` cards: a DAG of upstream detector slugs and fusion nodes. Mirrors the existing `detector_graph.schema.json` shape inline here for self-containment.
